subject: POC environment — ReadySet MAP: provisioning checklist & timeline
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@readyset.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@readyset.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ReadySet POC kickoff & environment needs

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. ReadySet is keen to run a 4-week POC focused on latency/cost comparisons for our chat use case. To get started our infra team asked for a short mutual action plan that lists the environment items we need to validate and timelines for closing them.

Top-of-mind items: API keys for the POC account, org setup so we can invite our engineers, IP allowlist for our NAT egress, and a VPC peering option for direct traffic to your Dedicated nodes (if available during the POC). We also attached our standard security questionnaire.

Can you confirm what you need from us and an estimate for when the environment can be live? We are hoping to start validation the week of Oct 5.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering, ReadySet AI
alex.j@readyset.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: readyset-security-questions.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@readyset.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReadySet POC kickoff & environment needs

Hi Alex —

Great to hear ReadySet is moving forward. I put together a short MAP below that maps each deliverable to an owner and a target completion window so we can hit your Oct 5 validation start. See the quick checklist and next steps.

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- API keys: Redwood will create a scoped POC API key tied to a ReadySet project. Action: Marissa (Provision). Target: 2026-10-01 EOD.
- Org invitation & roles: Invite ReadySet engineers to the POC org with Developer and Billing views for benchmarking. Action: Neha. Target: 2026-10-02.
- IP allowlist: Provide CIDR(s) to allow client-side egress to Redwood endpoints. Action: ReadySet infra (Alex) to provide CIDR; Karthik to confirm routing. Target: 2026-09-30.
- VPC peering (optional): Technical feasibility call and initial peering request. Action: Karthik to assess; Marissa to collect RFC. Target: feasibility check by 2026-10-03, peering window TBD.
- Security questionnaire: Marissa will reply with our SOC2 summary and a short evidence pack. Target: 2026-10-01.

Attachments: map checklist (I attached a provisioning checklist with the specific fields we will use to provision the POC user/org).

Next steps
1) Alex — please confirm the NAT egress IPs/CIDRs and a primary Slack channel for quick coordination.
2) I’ll provision the POC project and generate a scoped API key once we have the ReadySet org contact list.
3) Karthik will loop in infra for the peering feasibility call; propose Oct 1 or Oct 2.

If anything on the timeline is aggressive for your team, call it out and we’ll adjust.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: readyset-map-provisioning-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@readyset.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@readyset.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReadySet POC kickoff & environment needs

Neha —

Thanks, that is really clear. Quick answers:
- CIDRs: 34.82.12.0/24 (NAT pool A), 34.82.13.0/24 (NAT pool B).
- Org invite list: I will share a Google Sheet with the three engineers (emails included) by EOD.
- Peering: we are open to peering, but we will likely prefer a transit gateway connection if that is simpler. Let Karthik and your infra team advise.

We can do a short call Oct 1 at 11:00 PT to walk through peering requirements. Our procurement contact is on copy for timing of paperwork — they will push the SOW/PO once dates are locked.

Alex

On Sep 28, 2026, at 11:06 AM, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (see MAP and checklist)

Attachment: readyset-nat-cidrs.txt (txt)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@readyset.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReadySet POC kickoff & environment needs — peering feasibility slot

Neha / Marissa —

Following up on the peering ask. Quick notes from infra:
- For the initial POC we can support an ingress via public API with IP allowlist — lowest friction and fastest to validate latency.
- VPC peering is possible, but we need the ReadySet VPC IDs and a short peering form (I filled a stub in the provisioning checklist). If you want transit gateway we'll need a partner cloud account and that adds 3–5 business days.
- I can join the Oct 1 11:00 PT call to walk the team through the minimal route table changes and security groups.

Action items I’ll own:
1) Draft peering RFC and share on Oct 1 morning.
2) Provision a temporary POC host in our staging region so you can run egress tests once CIDRs are allowed.

Marissa — please hold the scoped API key until Alex confirms the final invite list.

Cheers,
Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@readyset.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@readyset.ai, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReadySet POC kickoff & environment needs — keys & evidence pack

Alex —

Quick operational update:
- I created the scoped POC API key; will only activate once the invite list is received. Key will be limited to 50 requests/min and token expiration set to 7 days for the POC.
- Security pack: attached SOC2 summary and a redacted audit log sample. Evelyn will follow up if you need deeper artifacts.
- I uploaded the peering RFC draft to the provisioning checklist and flagged the transit gateway cost delta.

If we’re aligned, next concrete steps are: Alex shares the invite sheet + confirm when procurement will sign the SOW, Alex opens the NAT egress allowlist change with your cloud team, and we run a short validation test on Oct 5.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), redwood-auditlog-sample.csv (csv)
